posts.lede: Benchmark prices slipped again in September while inventory sits well above normal. A strong month to buy.
posts.source: Source: Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, September 2026 market report. Benchmark prices, MLS® HPI. Not intended to solicit properties currently listed for sale.
posts.caption:
📊 Fraser Valley market update: September 2026

Prices softened again last month, and buyers have more choice than they've had in years:

🏡 Detached benchmark: $1,300,000 (down 8.8% from last year)
🏘️ Townhome: $745,300 (down 6.2%)
🏢 Apartment: $461,800 (down 9.3%)

📈 9,763 active listings, 31% above the 10-year seasonal average
🔑 922 sales, about the same as last September

What it means: if you've been waiting on the sidelines in Surrey, Langley or North Delta, this is a market where buyers can negotiate. DM me or call 604.562.4004 for a free price check on any neighbourhood.

posts.note_html: Under 12% sales-to-active is a buyer's market. Surrey buyers have room to negotiate on price, conditions and possession dates.
posts.source: Source: Fraser Valley Real Estate Board municipal report, September 2026. Ratio calculated from sales ÷ active listings. Not intended to solicit properties currently listed for sale.
posts.caption:
📍 Surrey market snapshot: September 2026

Benchmark prices:
🏡 Detached $1,386,200
🏘️ Townhouse $758,600
🏢 Apartment $447,600

404 homes sold against 4,293 active listings. That's a 9.4% sales-to-active ratio, which puts Surrey firmly in buyer's market territory (under 12%).

For buyers, that means more choice and real room to negotiate. For sellers, pricing right from day one matters more than ever.

Thinking about a move in Surrey? Call or text 604.562.4004 and I'll send you the numbers for your exact neighbourhood.

posts.note_html: Langley is holding up better than the wider Fraser Valley, sitting in the 12–20% balanced range. Well-priced homes are still moving.
posts.source: Source: Fraser Valley Real Estate Board municipal report, September 2026 (City and Township combined). Ratio calculated from sales ÷ active listings. Not intended to solicit properties currently listed for sale.
posts.caption:
📍 Langley market snapshot: September 2026

Benchmark prices (City + Township):
🏡 Detached $1,471,100
🏘️ Townhouse $802,600
🏢 Apartment $525,900

226 homes sold with 1,438 active listings, a 15.7% sales-to-active ratio. That's balanced territory (12–20%), so Langley is holding steadier than the Fraser Valley overall.

Townhomes in areas like Willoughby and Walnut Grove are a popular choice for growing families. Want a list of what's available in your price range? DM me or call 604.562.4004.

posts.caption:
💡 $460,000.

That's how far the benchmark price of a detached home in the Fraser Valley has dropped from its March 2022 peak, according to the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board.

Today's detached benchmark is $1,300,000, and active listings are 31% above the 10-year average for this time of year. Translation: more homes to choose from, more room to negotiate, and less pressure to waive conditions.
